title: Concrete Godement mapping fibre defining the ring complex
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subset A$ an ideal. Put $U(A,I)=\operatorname{Spec}(A)\setminus V(I)$ using [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Use the actual product-of-stalks Godement construction [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model], with its prescribed cosimplicial terms, cofaces, codegeneracies and germ augmentation from [lem-sc-module-cup-godement-model-pairing-models-exist]. Let $G_U$ be the alternating coface complex of this model for $\mathcal O_U$, extended by zero from $\mathbf N$ to $\mathbf Z$. Let $J(A,I)$ be its global-section complex, with scalars restricted along $A\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ and placed as constant module sheaves on the one-object bottom site [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data]. Restriction followed by the germ augmentation defines a cochain map $\rho:A[0]\to J(A,I)$: the first differential composite is zero by the augmentation's cochain equation. Define $K(A,I)=\operatorname{Cone}(\rho)[-1]$, using the first object of the inverse rotation of the standard mapping-cone triangle; define $\epsilon_{A,I}:K(A,I)\to A[0]$ to be its first morphism. These are actual constructions, including all differentials. The only model choice specifies its terms and all cofaces and codegeneracies, so determines the extended complex and augmentation up to the equality used downstream. No data come from an arbitrary witness of mere existence.
